lines.en: I nibble my way along the leaf edge.
My body arches as I go.
I grip the leaf edge with my front feet.
I crawl from leaf to leaf.
I move to the middle of the leaf.
I poke my head out for tender spots.
My feet cling to the leaf.
I skirt carefully around the tip.
I crawl under the leaf.
I inch toward the stem.
Each step covers very little.
I move sideways along the leaf.
I reach across from the twig.

lines.zh: 我挪开时叶子晃了一下
lines.en: The leaf dips when I move.
I pause, then crawl on.
I stay on this one leaf.
I lie still on the leaf.
I hold a bite of leaf.
I rest on the vein.
My body swells slowly.
I pull my head in a little.
I bask in the middle of the leaf.
My feet hold tight.
I chew slowly.
I have bitten a notch in the edge.
I lift my little head to look about.
No rush; I take my time.
I shift my body.
I raise my face toward you.

lines.zh: 我抬头，你就在叶子外面。
lines.en: I look up; you are just beyond the leaf.
I do not intend to come down.
Do not touch this leaf.
I go back to my leaf.
You are blocking the light.
I shrink back under the leaf.
I will stay right here.
My body does not move.
Waiting below will not help you.
I curl into a ball at once.
I arch my back up in pain.
I drop to the leaf below.
Green fluid seeps from my mouth.
My body goes still.
I straighten out bit by bit.
I grip the vein.
I am still gasping in little pulls.
I cannot crawl an inch.
I lie still, afraid to move.
The leaf's smell has changed.
I only eat leaves.
I inch toward the tender leaf.
I bite and spit it out.
That is not a leaf.
I crawl around it.
I go on with my leaf.
I touch nothing else.
My antennae probe it and pull back.
I move onto a fresh leaf.
The knock makes me slide.
I grab the leaf at once.
I almost slip off the edge.
The leaf rocks under me.
You knocked off a bit of leaf.
I curl up tight.
I uncurl slowly.
I have not left this leaf.
I tighten my grip again.
A bump does not frighten me.
Another crawls up beside me.
Our bodies touch.
We chew the same leaf.
It crawls over my back.
We are both on the vein.
Its body is a stretch shorter.

lines.zh: 我们一同往叶片中间去
lines.en: We both head for the middle of the leaf.

lines.zh: 我们两个一点声都没有
lines.en: Neither of us makes a sound.
It stops beside me.
We each chew our own patch.
I bite off a piece of leaf.
I chew it slowly.
I swallow this bite of leaf.
I gnaw off one more bite.
There is a new gap in the leaf.
I move to another leaf.
I roll off the leaf edge.
I catch the stem.
I search along the vein.
I hump my way back.
I stop.
A shadow falls on the leaf.
I pull my head in.

lines.zh: 丛林叶子上，我缩起来了。
lines.en: On a jungle leaf, I curl up.
I want to get under the leaf.
I shift toward the stem.
The leaf has started to rustle.
I hold still first.

lines.zh: 我贴在叶子最厚的地方
lines.en: I press to the leaf's thickest part.
I turn slowly to the sound.
I tuck myself along the vein.
I stay under the leaf.
It has not found me yet.
I inch toward the leaf tip.
The leaf dips when I move.
I hold still until it moves off.
My body lies flat on the leaf.
I wait for the light to return.
It has gone round the leaf's far side.
I lie still a little longer.
I have no way to bite it.
I open my mouth and bite only stem.
I squeeze into the leaf fold.
I roll behind the leaf.
I have no strength to fight.
All I can do is curl up.
I spit out green fluid.
I twist my body once.
I start crawling again.
I cling to the leaf.

lines.zh: 我在这片叶子上孵出来
lines.en: I hatch on this leaf.

lines.zh: 叶子边缘有细细的咬痕
lines.en: Fine bites mark the leaf's edge.
I lift my head a little at a time.
The first thing I do is eat.
I find my way along the vein.
The egg's film still clings to me.
I take my first bite.
This leaf will feed me a long while.
I come around from under the leaf.
I crawl another inch.
My body dries in the heat.
I fall off the leaf.
Water rises and I lose my grip.
The blast knocks me off the leaf.
Something goes through me.
Spell light makes me curl.
Off the leaf, I starve.
Lightning shows through the leaves.
The leaf is gone; I fall.
